newsitem.title: RUSSIA: UTC plans double investments in Russia.
newsitem.headline: UTC plans double investments in Russia.

text.p: United Technologies Corporation (UTC) plans to increase investments in Russia to $250 million from $125 million in a few next years, an official in the U.S. engineering group's Moscow office said on Monday.
UTC subsidiaries Pratt and Whitney, Carrier, Hamilton Standard and Otis are already active in Russia.
"UTC's joint ventures in Russia already employ over 10,000 Russians, making UTC one of the largest joint venture employers outside the energy sector," the company said in a statement.
UTC's board of directors were to meet in St Petersburg on Monday, said the official, who asked not to be named.
He did not give the details of the meeting's agenda.
